title: AEIBMemoryDigest_v1_1_Draft
description: AEIB v1.1 specification draft schema for Multi-Tier Memory Binding and Temporal Staleness evaluation (TemporalMemoryDigest in v1.1-roadmap/unified_governance_stack.py). Enforces separation between Ephemeral Context (Model), Persistent Workspace (Fact), and Authorization Standing (Boundary), defaulting to STALE_DONT_TRUST_YET when source_epoch or policy_epoch advances.

schema_version.description: Version identifier for the AEIB v1.1 TemporalMemoryDigest specification draft.

memory_digest.description: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 digest over RFC 8785 JCS canonicalized {contextCaid, policyEpoch, sourceEpoch}.

context_caid.description: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 Content-Addressed Action/Context Identifier computed over flushed workspace fact bytes (excluding ephemeral reasoning fields _reasoning, chain_of_thought, rationale, explanation).

memory_tier.description: Three-tier memory isolation classification separating model reasoning context (EPHEMERAL_CONTEXT), persistent workspace facts (WORKSPACE_FACT), and boundary standing grants (STANDING_GRANT).

source_epoch.description: Monotonic epoch of the authoritative retrieval or workspace fact source at the moment the MemoryDigest was bound.

policy_epoch.description: Monotonic epoch of the authorization policy or standing grant at the moment the MemoryDigest was bound.

active_source_epoch.description: Observed active source epoch at pre-dispatch evaluation time.

active_policy_epoch.description: Observed active policy epoch at pre-dispatch evaluation time.

status.description: Temporal freshness disposition. Transitions from FRESH to STALE_DONT_TRUST_YET whenever active_source_epoch != source_epoch or active_policy_epoch != policy_epoch.

dispatch_admissible.description: Pre-dispatch standing predicate result. True only when status is FRESH and both source_epoch and policy_epoch match the active epochs; false engages a fail-closed halt (GovernanceHaltError).

heartbeat_pulse_hash.description: Optional PAD-016 cryptographic heartbeat pulse digest binding temporal liveness to the memory envelope.

key_sorting.description: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3 UTF-16 code unit key ordering.
